measured: bulk IN bytes after writing one byte value at one address of a register space the byte scans had not covered, on top of the baseline
bench: RTL2832U + R820T-family tuner, 28.8 MHz crystal, behind a USB analyzer with switchable TARGET-A power; no signal source, antenna input sees noise only
candidate_space: USB block (request block 1, Table 28), wValue = 0x2000 + offset (step 1A): offset 0x00..=0x1FF (wValue 0x2000..=0x21FF) x value 0x00..=0xFF, except the value the address holds when its candidate comes up (logged as kind s); iterated offset, value in ascending order with no reordering; 131072 candidates
bound: [RTL2832U] Table 29 (p. 38) maps the USB block as USB_SYSCTL 0x0000, USB_EPA_CFG 0x0144, USB_EPA_CTL 0x0148, USB_EPA_MAXPKT 0x0158, USB_EPA_FIFO_CFG 0x0160 (each 32-bit, Tables 30-34) with reserved ranges 0x0004-0x0140, 0x014C-0x0154, 0x015C and 0x0164-0x0FFF. 0x000-0x1FF covers every named register, every reserved gap among them and 0x0164-0x01FF after the last one; outside the bound lies only the reserved 0x0200-0x0FFF (3584 bytes), a later declaration if this one is empty
byte_addressing: USB and system registers are 32-bit little-endian words (step 1A, data/step1-sys-usb-encoding.json; step 1D, data/step1-writes.json); byte reads inside them work (step 1A); each candidate is one byte written with wLength 1 at one address, and whether the chip takes a one-byte write into a 32-bit register is what the read-back (in / rb) records; demodulator pages are byte registers
already_known: step 1A/1D: power-on USB_SYSCTL 0x01, USB_EPA_CFG 0xD1, USB_EPA_CTL 0, USB_EPA_MAXPKT 0x200, USB_EPA_FIFO_CFG 0x14; USB_EPA_MAXPKT written as a 32-bit word reads back (data/step1-writes.json); the baseline sets EPA_MAXPKT 0x200, EPA_CFG 0xD1, pulses the FIFO reset, clears the stall bit, sets DMA (data/step3-baseline.json). Step 3 detector-check: USB_EPA_CTL bit 4 halts the endpoint, ClearFeature(ENDPOINT_HALT) clears both the halt and the chip's bit
hazards: USB_SYSCTL (0x00-0x03): bit 10 (offset 0x01 bit 2) SIE reset - expected to drop the device off the bus until a power cycle; bit 3 full-packet mode; bit 0 DMA enable. USB_EPA_CFG (0x144-0x147): endpoint enable, type, number. USB_EPA_CTL (0x148-0x14B): bit 4 stalls the endpoint (the detector clears the halt and records it), bit 9 FIFO reset, bit 5 flush. USB_EPA_MAXPKT (0x158), USB_EPA_FIFO_CFG (0x160). The USB baseline items are re-checked after every candidate
method: plain, as data/step3-bytescan.jsonl: the value is written into the running chip with no restart between candidates (METHODS.md section 5: every declared space covered once before any is repeated with a variant)
settings_held_fixed: documented-only baseline at 2400000 Hz; 4 x 16384 byte bulk transfers queued; window 50 ms right after the read-back, then a 200 ms follow-up window if any byte arrived, then a 50 ms window after the restore
window_justification: the plain byte scan's (data/step3-bytescan.jsonl header): 4.8 MB/s fills a 16 KiB transfer every 3.4 ms, so 50 ms expects ~14.6 transfers (one-transfer quantisation 6.8 % < 20 % tolerance); any byte triggers the 200 ms follow-up, so a stream that starts up to ~50 ms after the write is still judged
streams_criterion: within 20% of 2 x 2400000 bytes/s in the window or the follow-up
line_legend: k: c candidate / s skip (the address's current value) / setup / recovery; o offset in the block (decimal); v value; orig the byte read before the write (null = the read failed); in the read-back after the write equals v; rb the read-back when it differs (absent when in); d bytes completed between candidates, discarded before the write (absent when 0); b bytes from the write to the end of the last window (window + follow-up); bps the follow-up window's bytes/s (absent without bytes); s streams; q the bulk detector's self-check from the previous candidate's last window to the end of the window, qf the same for the follow-up, qa for the after-restore window: [transfers submitted, completed, completed with an error, halts (Stall completions, each cleared by ClearFeature ENDPOINT_HALT), fewest transfers in flight, endpoint halted at any point 0/1]; e errors and events (absent when none); w wedged -> power cycle and re-baseline (next line k=recovery)
procedure: read the byte (skip if equal); discard completed transfers; write the value; read it back; window; on bytes the follow-up; restore the original and verify by read-back; on bytes the after-restore window; chip answering?; baseline re-checked (DEMOD_CTL, AD_EN, en_bbin, rsamp_ratio, USB_SYSCTL DMA, USB_EPA_CFG, USB_EPA_CTL, USB_EPA_MAXPKT): reapplied if disturbed, power cycle if it does not hold; a chip that stops answering or keeps streaming after the restore is power-cycled and re-baselined; the scan does not stop on a hit

power_cycle.skipped: --no-cycle: the dongle was opened as found, not power-cycled

baseline_writes.write: GPIO3: GPD[3]=0 output, GPOE[3]=1, GPO[3]=0 power on (Tables 16-19)
USB_EPA_CFG: enable, type bulk, number from the descriptor (Table 31)

detector: 4 bulk IN transfers of 16384 bytes kept in flight: every completion resubmitted at once, topped up before each wait; a Stall completion = endpoint halted -> queued transfers cancelled, ClearFeature(ENDPOINT_HALT) sent (USB 2.0 9.4.1, 9.4.5), its result recorded, queue refilled; every error completion counted by kind. Line fields q / qf / qa = [submitted, completed, errored, halts, fewest in flight, halted at any point 0/1]
